notes.title: 9-nine-:Episode 3 Release on Steam!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34412484/27b9cdef33b9ec578dd7e28d2bb4d5663f8ea6db.png
The wait is over! Episode 3 in the 9-nine- series is officially out on Steam! The release is playable in English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese languages. We highly recommend playing Episode 1&2 before starting on Episode 3. With that said, we hope you enjoy the release and look forward to Episode 4 coming soon as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/976390/9nineEpisode_1/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1033420/9nineEpisode_2/
